text:
Priya: Heads-up: aiming to lock run-of-show and routing for the May 4 webinar by EOD Friday. Core theme: "Practical inference runbooks for product teams". Need detailed microtiming and owner for each cue.
Max: Sounds good. I want a hard 40-45m main session + optional 25m tech breakout. Keep total commute time <90m.
Zoe: For audience targeting, suggest two registration paths: Product/PM and Infrastructure/Platform. Different post-webinar followups.
Liam: I'll build the reg form. Question: do we want a pre-event poll (one question) to route people into breakout?
Priya: Yes — poll: "Primary interest: cost, latency, or deployment". Use checkboxes so people can pick multiple. Route leads based on primary selection.
Ana: Who owns slide deck finalization and sequencing? I can own narrative but need someone to QA technical accuracy.
Ruth: I can QA the technical slides and the benchmarks. Also will compile a short "demo failure script" (what to play if live demo breaks).
Max: Rehearsal plan: two full runs (one with green-room), one dress rehearsal the day before. Suggested slots: 5/1 11:00 PT (green-room), 5/2 09:00 PT (dress).
Zoe: I'm available 5/1 11:00. :thumbsup:
Liam: Reg form fields: name, email, company, role, primary interest, product stage. I'll include hidden utm_campaign=may_inference_runbook.
Priya: Nurture paths: product leads get playbook + highlights; infra leads get eval harness + benchmark slides; mixed leads get both and assigned to SDRs.
Max: SDR routing: @sales-bot can you create routing rules?
sales-bot: Creating rule: tag=product -> route_to=product_sdr; tag=infra -> route_to=infra_sdr; fallback=general_sdr. Rule created.
Ana: Run-of-show draft (microtiming):
- 0:00-3:00 host intro + agenda + housekeeping
- 3:00-10:00 customer story (Priya to coordinate with customer)
- 10:00-20:00 demo 1 (Zoe) live: KV cache & latency tradeoffs (8-10m)
- 20:00-30:00 demo 2 (Ruth) live: batching/throughput + cost slide (8-10m)
- 30:00-38:00 panel: product + runtime + customer (moderated)
- 38:00-45:00 live Q&A (moderator + panel)
- 45:00-70:00 optional breakout for deep tech 

Priya: Love it. Add a 60s transition slide between demos to allow for demo swap if needed.
Liam: I'll add automated timer overlay for host to see remaining time. Include a 2-min buffer for handing to Q&A.
Zoe: Demos — please provide a 2-min pre-record clip that mirrors the live steps. Upload to s3://redwood-webinar/may4/demos/ by 5/1 EOD.
Ruth: I'll record mine tomorrow and upload. Also adding a short runbook file called demo-fallback.txt with exact swap commands.
Ana: Captioning & languages: English captions + Spanish auto-translate. @ops-bot can you confirm vendor coverage?
ops-bot: Caption vendor supports English live captions and post-event Spanish auto-translate. Available in region us-east-1.
Priya: Speaker bios & 2-line abstracts due by 4/28 EOD. Paste here when ready.
Zoe: Abstract: "Real-world caching patterns that reduce tail latency and token spend." Bio: "Zoe 94 Staff Engineer, builds runtime features for low-latency inference."
Ruth: Abstract: "Batching strategies for throughput-first workloads 94 live demo and cost breakdown." Bio: "Ruth 94 Senior Infra Engineer, focuses on batching and autoscaling policies."
Priya: Customer blurb coming from Acme by tomorrow morning.
Max: Slide review: please drop deck into /marketing/shared/decks/may4 by 5/1 12:00 PT for comments. I'll consolidate feedback and lock slides 5/2 17:00 PT.
Ana: Recording retention: keep raw recording + captions for 180 days. Also gate replay behind lead capture form.
Liam: Setting retention=180d and gating=on.
Zoe: Engagement: add one interactive poll mid-session: "Which lever will you try next? (Caching / Quantization / Batching)" We'll show live results.
Max: Good. Also add CTA slide with playbook link + contact card for product and infra.
Priya: Who owns follow-up email sequences? I will draft two versions (product & infra) and send to comms for QA. Due 5/3.
Ruth: Rehearsal checklists: mic check 30m prior, demo endpoint smoke 20m prior, S3 demo clip accessible, host test of timer overlay 15m prior.
Ana: Emergency swap protocol: if live demo fails, host has 90s to decide to swap. After 90s, automatically play pre-recorded demo and note in chat that it's pre-recorded.
Liam: I'll wire a "deploy clip" button in the producer console to trigger the pre-recorded asset.
ops-bot: Producer console deploy button ready in staging. Test scheduled 4/30 10:00 PT.
Priya: Great. Final ask: please paste your one-line speaker bio + final abstract by 4/28 EOD in this thread so Sam can build the registration page.
Zoe: Done above.
Ruth: Done above.
Priya: Thanks team 94 we'll sync on slide handoff tomorrow 11:00 PT.
